item.description: India unveiled a sweeping budget for 2026-27, pledging to accelerate economic growth through massive investments in manufacturing, infrastructure, and job creation, while maintaining fiscal discipline in a volatile global environment. item.description: The United States and India have formally agreed a wide-ranging trade deal, announced on 2 February 2026, aimed at resetting economic ties after nearly a year of escalating tariff tensions that had strained relations between the world’s two largest democracies.
